title: Darby Allin vs. MJF: from a headlock to the world title
summary: An early rivalry returns years later with Darby’s first world championship and a title-versus-hair rematch.

chapters.title: MJF wins with a headlock takeover
chapters.result: MJF pins Darby after using the diamond ring.
chapters.context: The humiliating finish becomes a reference point in their later rivalry.

chapters.title: Darby becomes world champion
chapters.result: Darby defeats MJF for the AEW World Championship.
chapters.context: The long-time AEW original finally reaches the world title.

chapters.title: MJF regains the championship
chapters.result: MJF defeats Darby in the title-versus-hair match.
chapters.context: The rematch ends Darby’s first world-title reign.
